kind: synthetic minimal source-derived controls; not captured rendered production pages

derivation.metadata: All three classic form partials render form_basics; all three baseline wrappers render form_baseline, which renders form_basics. form_basics has name/license/implementation_languages text_field and description text_area. These four are unconditional within the shared partial.
derivation.criteria: _status_chooser calls status_radio_button with canonical status symbols and Met/Unmet/conditional N/A/? strings; projects_helper status_radio_button passes exact string values to the Rails form builder. _status_chooser emits justification_symbol text_area. Canonical symbols come from the pinned bundled criteria catalog.
derivation.coverage: Each fixture intentionally includes one representative canonical criterion and all four writable metadata controls. Routes, duplicate/missing/wrong-type controls, inherited disabled state, and direct runtime failures are varied by the test harness. This is DOM conformance against source-derived controls, not a deployed BadgeApp observation.
